name: MCPGuard
description: A security gateway that enforces policies, tracks data taints, and sandboxes tool calls between AI agents and MCP servers. It provides a secure chokepoint to prevent prompt injection and ensure OWASP ASI compliance through audit logging and deterministic execution.

rawRecord.description: A security gateway that enforces policies, tracks data taints, and sandboxes tool calls between AI agents and MCP servers. It provides a secure chokepoint to prevent prompt injection and ensure OWASP ASI compliance through audit logging and deterministic execution.

MCPGUARD_PROXY__HOST.description: Host for the security gateway. Default: 127.0.0.1

MCPGUARD_PROXY__PORT.description: Port for the security gateway. Default: 8000

MCPGUARD_TAINT__MODE.description: Taint tracking mode. Options: decorator, ebpf, hybrid, disabled. Default: hybrid

MCPGUARD_SANDBOX__BACKEND.description: Execution backend for tools. Options: docker, firecracker, wasm, microsandbox. Default: docker

MCPGUARD_POLICY__POLICY_PATHS.description: Paths to YAML policy files, typically provided as a list or string.

MCPGUARD_POLICY__DEFAULT_ACTION.description: Default action for policy evaluation (e.g., allow, deny, audit, sandbox). Default: deny

MCPGUARD_OBSERVABILITY__LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level for the server. Default: info

MCPGUARD_SANDBOX__TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Timeout for sandbox execution in seconds. Default: 30

MCPGUARD_OBSERVABILITY__METRICS_ENABLED.description: Whether to enable Prometheus metrics. Default: true
